title_zh: 用具体服务事例准备志愿者提名

scenario.label_zh: 志愿者表彰提名的证据
scenario.goal_zh: 以具体服务记录支持提名，说明奖项不含现金并分工准备提名文字和核对事实

context_zh: 社区组织者准备年度志愿者表彰提名。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Clara
sentences.text: Ana deserves recognition for keeping the reading club going all winter.

sentences.speaker: Yusuf
sentences.text: She has a remarkable ability to make new readers feel welcome. Can we give an example?

sentences.speaker: Clara
sentences.text: She made large-print copies for three sessions and arranged lifts for people who could not walk here.

sentences.speaker: Yusuf
sentences.text: That is stronger than simply saying she has a good reputation. What is the reward this year?

sentences.speaker: Clara
sentences.text: A certificate and a tree planted in her name, not a cash prize.

sentences.speaker: Yusuf
sentences.text: Then I'll draft the nomination around those two examples.

sentences.speaker: Clara
sentences.text: Good. I'll check the dates in the club records before we submit it.
